headline: Crypto TVL and DEX Volumes: Ethereum Leads at $51.4B on 2026-10-09
summary: Ethereum holds the top TVL position at $51.4B, followed by Solana at $6.25B and Base at $6.16B. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.58B while Tether generated the most fees at $17.5M. USDT leads stablecoins with $184B circulating and Base leads L2 TVS at $15.5B. Multiple stablecoin depegs and eight DeFi incidents were reported in the prior 14 days.
